name: rustup
description: Rust toolchain installer and version manager

avoid.scoop: scoop's installer sets CARGO_HOME and RUSTUP_HOME to its own folder before rustup-init runs, so toolchains never land in the XDG folders.

RUSTUP_HOME.guide: rustup keeps absolute paths inside ~/.rustup and ~/.cargo; follow https://rust-lang.github.io/rustup/installation/index.html to move them.

CARGO_HOME.guide: rustup keeps absolute paths inside ~/.rustup and ~/.cargo; follow https://rust-lang.github.io/rustup/installation/index.html to move them.

picker.header: Select Rust toolchain  [Enter to make it the default]
